case.name: except_after_points
case.sql: SELECT count(*),sum(x) FROM (SELECT x FROM (SELECT t.seq AS x,t.seq AS seq,t.grp AS grp FROM t JOIN u ON u.id=t.seq WHERE (t.grp=15 OR t.seq%2=0)) EXCEPT SELECT v FROM u);
case.prepare: WITH RECURSIVE c(i) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT i+1 FROM c WHERE i<1000) SELECT sum((SELECT v FROM t WHERE id=printf('%016x', 1+(c.i*2654435761)%65536))) FROM c;
